title: Welcome to My Personal Blog
summary: Welcome to my new personal blog! Here I will share my thoughts, software engineering tutorials, and lessons learned while coding.
content:
Welcome to my personal blog!

This platform was built from the ground up using Python, Flask, and a lightweight filesystem-based storage architecture. Instead of relying on a heavyweight relational database, articles are stored as structured JSON files directly on disk.

### Why Build a Personal Blog?

1. **Learning by Doing**: Implementing server-rendered HTML, form handling, session authentication, and filesystem operations is one of the best ways to master backend fundamentals.
2. **Simplicity & Speed**: Zero external database dependencies make deployment and local development fast and portable.
3. **Full Creative Control**: Complete ownership over design, typography, performance, and features.

Stay tuned for upcoming posts on Python programming, clean code, design patterns, and full-stack software development!
